description.value: HellCrust Pizza is a fast-food pizza chain location on Lougheed Highway in Maple Ridge, offering both delivery and carry-out. The location sits along a major arterial route making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the corridor. As a late-night operation it may be one of the few food options open for evening riders in this part of the valley.
